evidenceBoundary: Journey specifications grounded in source. This file is not a record of executed UI, authorization, provider, or live acceptance tests.
fixturesPolicy: Synthetic identities and records only. No participant data, secret values, provider egress, database connection, or live mutation in standalone review.

scenarios.title: Sign in, reach the right workspace, return safely

steps.action: Sign in with one synthetic identity per role
steps.expected: Return to the authorized requested destination; reject external redirect targets.

steps.action: Open a member deep link as a member and a staff-only identity
steps.expected: Member renders; staff baseline member row does not grant member entitlement.

steps.action: Switch to the assigned counselor workspace
steps.expected: Only server-resolved available roles are offered.

steps.action: Open an employer link with and without an account association
steps.expected: Associated employer opens; unlinked user gets the established access destination.

steps.action: Open a partner link with and without an account association
steps.expected: Associated partner opens; denied redirects terminate without a loop.

steps.action: Return through the role switcher and browser Back
steps.expected: The active role and navigation remain correct; no unauthorized data flashes.

assertions: Verify content-level authorization, not just HTTP 200.
Unknown routes must show not-found, not a home skeleton.
Keep requested query/tab when safe; no redirect loops.
scenarios.boundary: All mutations are simulated in the review experience; provider egress is blocked.

Completed, pending, unavailable, and locked steps have distinct labels.

assertions: Do not infer completion from route visits.
No fictional readiness score, counselor, employer, or weekly plan appears as live data.

scenarios.title: Member message → correct staff thread → reply

steps.action: Read history and write a fixture draft
steps.expected: Use server timestamps; keep the draft and reading position.
Counselor sees the current assignment and correct unread count.

steps.action: Open the same thread from a member record
steps.expected: The query opens Messages; browser Back returns to the prior list.

steps.action: Review an explicitly authorized staff route
steps.expected: Staff message links never send staff to the member inbox.

steps.action: Receive a fixture reply while reading history
steps.expected: New message affordance appears without pulling a reader away.

assertions: DB createdAt is carried through each UI mapper; format in America/Chicago.
Only persisted response is sent; email delivery is a separate state.
Reconcile an ambiguous POST before retrying; no universal idempotency guarantee exists.
GET /api/member/messages may create and assign; block it in standalone mockups.
scenarios.boundary: The standalone review simulates threads; the live GET can create a thread and assign staff. Do not use an unrestricted live crawler or real send for this journey.
